title: Master Thesis Project Repository
summary: A master's thesis repository documenting research, datasets, and machine learning models for synthetic tabular data generation, apparently applied to aerospace/aircraft performance data such as Breguet's range. The thesis notebooks import and run SDV's CTGANSynthesizer, TVAESynthesizer, SingleTableMetadata, and evaluation utilities (run_diagnostic, evaluate_quality) alongside the standalone ctgan and sdmetrics packages to generate and score synthetic data.
needs: Directory 'Model & Results_New/CTGAN' may contain vendored CTGAN artifacts or just saved model outputs; unclear if any SDV-family source is copied in-tree rather than just pickled models.
